display_name: 源域教师指导的独立相位恢复网络
description: 独立时频学生网络加入整体复数幅相校正，在源训练中以冻结 DURA 波形和 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL 特征为教师，推理不依赖 DURA。
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发 Phase1 恢复网络，不拘泥 DURA，地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；不使用 Phase3。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI Python GPU3 if idle; two CPU threads

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: float32 IQ [2,256]; source L_s/U_s paired clean and simulated post_sync residual channel
data.label_map_ref: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract, six classes
data.tx_sets_ref: No TX labels or U_s truth read; frozen DURA and Tri-SIG-TIME SSL predictions guide source training
data.validation_ref: 7840 RX4/6 day3 source IDs and 3921 RX8 day3 exploratory heldout on cache18; IDs previously used in gate source selection under other channel views; all excluded student training; no V
data.leo_config_ref: Source cache epochs1–5 for training, epoch18 for source selection; seven Phase1 simulated practical scenes

permissions.query_use: No target data until all source selection fixed; then seven-view predictions before truth; no Phase3
permissions.claim_scope: Single seed, source heldout and Phase1 development previously observed, no independent-blind or real satellite claim

checkpoint.initialization: Fixed source semantic direct epoch5 weights plus newly initialized global complex gain head, frozen input-only gate, frozen DURA and frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: core.data checks physical IDs against Tri-SIG-TIME roles; parent commit exact
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: cache18 RX4/6 day3 clean F pseudo target and paired IQ, vs frozen DURA; epochs1/3/5 alpha .5/1 gate thresholds .8/.99; per cell loss <=max(1,0.5%), clean IQ <= DURA+.001 and impaired IQ <=1.2x DURA+1e-6, net gain >=10; else retain DURA; RX8 not used selection

execution.launch_owner: Codex independent source teacher student single owner
execution.gpu_policy: GPU3 only if idle; one worker, two CPU threads

dimensions: source per receiver and scene F pseudo agreement
source clean preservation and gate rate
metrics_plan.scientific_rule: Goal six scenario accuracies versus clean ground SSL <=3 pp and also <=3% relative, clean protection, no blind claim.

rows.method: independent temporal-spectral student with global complex gain, frozen DURA IQ/logit teacher and Tri-SIG-TIME clean distribution; input-only gate; no DURA inference
rows.purpose: source student model and DURA-relative selection then Phase1 evaluation
rows.seed_notes: Fixed source prior IDs seed 2026110551; teacher student model seed 2026111154 and shuffled order seed 2026111155; cache epochs1–5/18; parent fixed weights
rows.scenario: source clean + six simulated scenarios, followed by seven full Phase1 views if selected
rows.budget_ref: 47143 source training IDs, gate-active subset, batch32, five epochs; source selection 7840 / exploratory heldout 3921

notes: DURA is used only as frozen source-training teacher and source/final comparator; independent deployed model accepts IQ without DURA.
No transmitter labels, U_s truth, V or target IQ read in training and source selection.
Source validation physical IDs were previously inspected in gate experiments under different views; not an independent blind sample.
Phase1 development test is historical nonblind simulated channel evaluation.
